displayName: NBD Pro — Client error spike (> 20 CRM browser errors in 15 min)

documentation.content:
More than 20 client_error reports reached the clientError function in a 15-minute window. Each browser tab sends a given error once and at most 10 per page load / 25 per tab session, so 20 in 15 minutes means several sessions or many distinct errors — typically a bad deploy of a docs/pro script.

Counts ERROR log entries from the clienterror service (the free logging.googleapis.com/log_entry_count metric, summed across revisions so a deploy does not split the count). The service logs nothing else at ERROR.

Investigate:
  gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="clienterror" AND jsonPayload.event="client_error"' --project nobigdeal-pro --freshness 1h --limit 100 --format 'value(jsonPayload.sig,jsonPayload.build,jsonPayload.view,jsonPayload.errorMessage)'
Group by sig and build; if one build introduced it, roll back per documentation/runbooks/ROLLBACK.md. Runbook: documentation/runbooks/CLIENT-ERROR-ALERTS.md.
